The '''2018 LPL Spring''' split was the first split of the year in China’s franchised '''LoL Pro League''' (''LPL''), organized by Tencent Games. Fourteen teams competed from 15 January to 28 April across venues in Shanghai, Hangzhou, Chongqing, and Chengdu. The league featured a two-conference Regular Season followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket, with the champion qualifying for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2018|MSI 2018]] and the top four teams advancing to [[Rift Rivals/LCK-LMS-LPL/2018|Rift Rivals 2018]]. Matches were played offline on patches ranging from 8.1 to 8.6.

This split included several roster and slot adjustments. [[Bilibili Gaming]] entered after acquiring the slot of [[I May]], while [[Topsports Gaming]] joined through the acquisition of [[Dan Gaming]]’s place. Originally, one new league slot was planned, but two additional teams, [[FunPlus Phoenix]] and [[Rogue Warriors]], were invited due to the removal of [[Newbee]] from the league.

Several teams had designated homegrounds for specific stages: [[LGD Gaming]] hosted matches at the LGD Gaming C & E Center in Hangzhou, [[Snake Esports]] played at the Chongqing Expo in Chongqing, [[Oh My God]] held games at the Eastern Suburb Memory in Chengdu, and the Finals took place at Chengdu Magic Cube.

===Playoffs===
{{#lst:LPL/2018/Spring/Playoffs|Playoffs}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** 2 groups of 6 teams each.
** Each team plays 16 matches.
*** Double Round Robin within own group
*** Single Round Robin against other group
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place of each group''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place of each group''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs, and will start the series with a 1-game advantage.
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|stay|''5th till 7th place of each group''}} qualify for [[LPL/2018/Summer|Summer split]]
* '''Playoffs'''
** Single elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Top 4 qualifies for [[Rift Rivals/LCK-LMS-LPL/2018|Rival Rivals 2018 - LCK vs LMS vs LPL]]
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2018|MSI 2018]]
